purpose: Frozen, scene-independent confirmatory training/export package for five fresh scenes. Generation performs no training, export, or rendering.

scenes.split_notes: Both L1:1 and L2:11 occur in train and validation for every frozen seed.
For every frozen seed, train has 42 L1:1 plus the sole L1:0 row; validation has 14 L1:1 and therefore no rare L1:0 row.
For every frozen seed, train has 7 L2:11 and 13 L4:1111; validation has 3 L2:11 and 4 L4:1111.

scope.note: The repository's fair simple trainer is Phase 11; Phase 10 only constructs MaskedSeedDiffusionModel.
